transactions.expectedEffect: Add 0.000001 testnet NEAR to storage/operating balance only; leave payout ledger, limits, pause and worker authorization unchanged.

signingKey: Current testnet FullAccess key proven by Meteor for the authenticated owner; pin its key and next nonce before wallet dispatch.
requiredFreshChecks: testnet protocol 88 or separately reviewed compatibility
owner balance and current gas price
same organization, target, key, next nonce and exact unsigned bytes
owner-only capability true and payment-execution capability false
acceptance scope unused and no unresolved owner attempt
server-scoped prepared bytes and review match this plan
executionGate: Owner signing requires its own explicit gate plus this hash-verified exact scope. Payment execution remains independently disabled and worker stopped. The server persists a stable one-use consumption before wallet dispatch; unknown, failed or confirmed submissions cannot automatically rearm through refresh, restart, gate toggles or plan metadata changes. Restore the temporary owner gate after the test; retain read-only reconciliation.
stopOn: wallet quotes more than fee ceiling
any additional transaction or payment request
limitations: No independent security review is claimed.
Meteor sign-only and pre-broadcast signed-byte interception are unsupported by the pinned connector; the wallet performs broadcast internally.
A post-dispatch refusal, timeout or lost response retains the pinned attempt/hash. No automatic replacement or timeout-based unlock.
If Meteor reconstructs the transaction and reports a different hash, retain both IDs and stop for manual review.
The fee allowance is a conservative preflight estimate and stop condition, not a protocol-enforced token fee cap; the transaction enforces a 100 Tgas gas limit.
